component.name: Disc Writer
component.summary: Burn CDs, DVDs and Blu-ray discs

description.p: Disc Writer is a modern disc burner for the Linux desktop, driving the xorriso command-line tool. It builds data discs with a live capacity gauge and an exact pre-burn size check, appends sessions to open discs, verifies every burn (recorded MD5s for data discs, byte for byte for images), burns and saves ISO images, erases rewritable media and can simulate any job with the laser off.
The Flatpak carries its own xorriso, which runs inside the sandbox.
